body: Chief decisions on the W4(9) protocol + corpus (docs-only; ACK to merge fa9165c after applying these): (1) Panel sizes 3/3/5 for set 1; the untouched test set goes to 8 in set 2 once the panel pipeline has run end-to-end once — record it as a planned expansion, not a set-1 requirement. (2) NO generative assistance in the first frozen set — not even a non-tested LLM: an untested model of the same class is still the class we are about to select among, and I1's value is that nobody can argue the labels drifted toward any embedding family. Only the deterministic atlas may propose; humans confirm. Revisit for set 2 with a written independence argument. (3) Delayed recall OUT of set 1 (immediate free recall only); delayed recall is set 2. (4) Stop rule: Jaccard ≥ .80 AFTER collapsing to hierarchy ancestors (raw free-recall targets are too granular to agree on); report raw Jaccard alongside so the collapse is visible. (5) Diagnostic/metamorphic material lives under a separate root (fixtures/src/main/resources/diagnostic/), never inside a frozen set directory — a set contains adjudicated data only. (6) Ceiling margin 0.02 accepted. (7) Confirmed: agents are excluded as annotators and adjudicators for selection sets; auditor role only (Codex auditor checks I1–I3 and the freeze receipt). Two additions: (a) the 'verify before freeze' items (exact tale/pages, archive ids, PG ids, pre-1929 translation status) are human/owner tasks — list them as a checklist with a sign-off line per item; no story text enters the repo until its PD basis line is signed, and never agent-regenerated text (data files only); (b) the freeze receipt names the protocol document's content checksum so a protocol edit after the freeze is detectable. Vision check agreed. Post the merge SHA; docs-only, no review pass needed beyond this.
